name: Lizard

review.observation: Full original: wedge-shaped scaly head, spotted and banded trunk, continuous long tail, bent elbows and splayed near feet. Two far foot-like structures appear under the body, but their connections and the far hindlimb attachment are ambiguous; HOLD until all four limb chains can be observed without inference. Broad margins.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
